title: CoT Faithfulness Counterfactual Hint Benchmark for Small Models

original_idea.body: # CoT Faithfulness Counterfactual Hint Benchmark for Small Models. Inject subtle hints into MCQs and measure how often small open reasoning models change answers without verbalizing; report unfaithfulness rates.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Hint-injection on MCQ + verbalization counting on small open models; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused benchmark deliverable; building hint set + judging adds modest effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open small-model faithfulness characterization labs deprioritize.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on small reasoning models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Hint-injection paradigm established; small-open-model benchmark angle plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Paradigm exists; compact small-open-model benchmark plausibly open.
